about_blocks.text: The Healing Therapy Alliance is a collective alliance of professionals, including mind/body and integrative psychotherapists, wellness therapists, and addiction counselors. Our team-based approach values collaboration, individuality, and holistic healing. We have experience working with children, youth, adults, and families who have experienced trauma or struggle with mental wellness or addiction. Our therapists are highly trained and equipped with up-to-date trauma-specific practices grounded in neuroscience and evidence.

Our team-based approach values collaboration, individuality, and holistic healing. about_blocks.text: At the Healing Therapy Alliance, we offer individualized, wrap-around approaches to healing. Our services include psychotherapy, wellness therapy, and addiction counseling. We focus on healing the whole person, addressing concerns related to physical, cognitive, emotional, spiritual, and attachment systems. Our approach combines evidence-based practices such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, mindfulness, and somatic experiencing to create a balanced and personalized treatment plan.
